workflow: qwen-image-edit -> qwen-image-edit (charcoal normalize) -> qwen-image-layered (async, layer_2) -> alpha-trim -> cwebp
prompt_isolate: Isolate the "Great Job!" title lockup text (the large glossy white and orange letters with the purple outline and drop shadow) on a plain grey background. Remove everything else: the stars, confetti, speech bubbles, banner, hat, checkmark, cat, bat, and button.
prompt_charcoal: Change the background to a perfectly flat, solid, uniform dark charcoal background, no gradient, no texture, no shadows on the background.
prompt_layered:
Background layer: Plain dark grey background
Top layer: The exact same "Great Job!" text lockup (white letters G-r-e-a-t, orange/yellow letters J-o-b with exclamation mark, thick dark purple outline and shadow) on a transparent background. Keep it identical to the input image.
spellcheck: Great Job! - verified correct at full zoom
